title: Normalize weight formats, shard metadata, and tokenizer contract cleanup in model loader
creator: Maya Chen
description: Why: We have accumulated several incompatible weight file shapes, ad-hoc sharding metadata formats, and two tokenizer integration paths (legacy adapter + new vectorized tokenizer). This causes duplicated parsing code, fragile fallback logic, and extra memory pressure when loading large models. Goal: consolidate weight file readers into a single extensible adapter, standardize shard metadata (manifest schema v2), and move tokenizer initialization into the model loader pipeline so that tokenizers are loaded lazily with a single canonical contract. This will reduce model cold-start latency, reduce code duplication, and make future format upgrades smoother.
acceptance_criteria: A single weight format adapter interface exists and is implemented for .safetensors, .pt, and the internal sharded manifest v2
Model loader reads shard manifest v2 and reconstructs shard map without per-backend heuristics
Only one tokenizer initialization entrypoint is used by serving runtime (legacy adapter removed or behind feature-flag)
End-to-end smoke load test passes for gpt-medium-v1 (single-shard) and llama-13b-4k (multi-shard) within baseline memory envelopes
No regression in token-per-second throughput in our batch microbenchmarks (<=5% delta), and cold-start P95 improved by >=10% for sharded models
Automated compatibility tests added for older manifests to verify fallback behavior and documented in /docs/model-formats.md
steps: Spike: inventory all weight readers and tokenizer init paths (done, notes linked)
Design: propose adapter interface and shard manifest v2 schema (PRD + schema in Confluence)
Implement: weight adapter registry and migrate safetensors loader to adapter interface
Implement: shard manifest v2 reader and migration tool for v1 manifests
Refactor: centralize tokenizer init into ModelInit pipeline and wire to serving config
Test: add unit tests, e2e smoke tests, and perf microbenchmarks
Rollout: feature-flagged rollout for 2 weeks then remove legacy path after monitoring
